repair: Native observations carry the current writable editor description (role/label/identifier, without AXValue or selected text), bounded to 1024 UTF-8 bytes without splitting characters. Secure/disabled/noneditable or unavailable controls produce no description.

Each provider keeps focused_editor with its own screenshot/history and native tool outcomes. Browser inputs reject native focus metadata. The native capability descriptions explain that a rejected click does not establish a new typing target. Existing admission and dispatch requirements remain.

Pointer diagnostics now distinguish missing target frames, signed observation authority and target-pixel mismatches. Accessibility events retain notification names for opt-in test diagnosis; event classification/retirement behavior is unchanged.
findings: The original first-frame six-second click control passes. The focus red executes two failed methods; Fara/GUI requests omit the editor and every native callback sees nil. The initial Holo wait-history fixture also used an incorrect seconds key, corrected to the existing time schema before green.

Two focus green methods and six bounds/cancellation/history regressions pass. Current source compiles and the 15-second delayed typing control passes with four verified dispatches, exact Unicode, login/Resume and no replay. The delayed-typing bundle is named red but is a passing diagnostic, not a reproduced defect.

Three newly passing logical methods raise the conservative historical minimum to 318 Mac / 10 iOS. Renaming/strengthening the existing empty-sibling first-click method is not counted as a new method. This is not a full-suite or production acceptance claim.

GUI-Owl still ignores rejected clicks and the explicit Origin focus observation. It types Tokyo three times into Origin and leaves Destination empty. All six workers exit below the retained 4 GiB cap. Stop its full native task trials pending a concrete new hypothesis.

Holo at the explicit diagnostic 5 GiB cap correctly clicks Destination once. Its type proposal is rejected, then two further clicks reject. Both fields stay empty and the form remains open. Peak worker memory is 4505387008 bytes. The final diagnostic shows changed focused authority despite the same editor frame, and changed pixels within that focused target. This does not yet identify the cause of the earlier typing rejection.

Fara Q4 at the matching diagnostic 5 GiB cap recognizes failed focus and tries Tab after two missed click proposals; all three proposals reject, no input is sent, and both fields stay empty. Peak worker memory is 4323737600 bytes. Its final focused authority differs despite the same visible editor label/frame.

The no-inference 15-second control keeps the same independently retained AX target ID, exact value and selection. Two AXUIElementDestroyed notifications occur but do not retire that target. Waiting alone does not reproduce the model-run rejection.

All diagnostic workers exit and remove temporary credentials. Fara production selection and its 4 GiB cap remain unchanged. The 5 GiB trials isolate model/action behavior and do not qualify a 12 GB Mac.
next: Use the existing nativeTextTarget injection seam to collect AX return codes and lifecycle events across one model call, with no generated effects, to locate the changed binding or failed read.

Distinguish target retirement, transient AX read failure, actual focus/selection change and caret-only pixels before modifying admission. Avoid blanket keyboard blocking after rejected clicks: Fara tried a keyboard recovery, and general computer use must retain that option.
Broader model tasks, generic missing actions, production desktop composition, provider login, phone integration and whole-app 12 GB/thermal acceptance remain open.
